Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the walkthrough today. Attached is the first-draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v1.xlsx) from our side. Summary of the milestone we discussed that needs alignment:

- Target close date: 2026-07-31
- MAP milestone: Legal redlines (MSA/DPA/SLA) — owner confirmation + turnaround SLA
- Dependencies: Helion legal review -> Redwood redline response -> procurement PO -> Security questionnaire completion

Proposal (please confirm):
- Helion legal to provide initial redlines within 72 business hours of receiving the draft (fast-track if needed)
- Redwood legal will produce a first-pass response within 72 hours of receiving Helion redlines
- For DPA/SLA items that require product input, Ben will own the technical notes and aim for a 48–72 hour turnaround after internal review

Action items for you to confirm: who on your legal team will own the redline review (name + email) and whether the 72h initial pass is acceptable. If Helion can commit to that cadence, we can set a recurring rapid-track sync and keep the MAP on schedule.

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (milestones, owners, tentative dates)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20–30m legal sync if that helps.

Best,

Appreciate the clear MAP doc. I routed the draft to our legal and procurement leads. Quick notes from our side:

- Procurement: we will confirm PO timing after legal clearance; hope to have a PO within 3 business days after contract sign-off.
